milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The black wool block is placed inside the sheep pen at spawn-relative (12, 0, 7). The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. This is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks as it models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining oak logs causes them to drop as items that enter the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_log in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because shearing a sheep with shears produces 1-3 wool items that enter the player's inventory. The player starts with no wool, so having at least 1 white_wool confirms successful shearing. White wool is used because the summoned sheep are default white color (the black_wool in the scene is a placed block, not from a sheep).

Uses inventory_has because crafting diamond boots places them in the player's inventory. The player must complete the full chain: mine oak logs → craft planks → craft crafting table → place it → retrieve 4 diamonds from chest → craft diamond boots. The player starts with no diamond_boots, so having 1 confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A flat grassy area with two key zones: (1) A small cluster of oak logs near spawn for mining, plus a chest with 4 diamonds. (2) A fenced sheep pen ~10 blocks away containing 3 sheep and a black wool block on the ground. The player spawns with shears. No crafting table is provided — the player must craft one from oak logs to make diamond boots.
task_text: Complete the following tasks: Find the black wool block inside the sheep pen, then shear a sheep. Also, mine oak logs and use them to craft a crafting table, then craft diamond boots using diamonds from the nearby chest.
design_notes: Two parallel task chains: (A) find_black_wool → shear_sheep: black wool is inside the sheep pen, so finding it means the player has located the sheep. (B) mine_oak_log → craft_diamond_boots: no crafting table is pre-placed, so player must mine logs → craft planks → craft crafting table → open chest for diamonds → craft diamond boots. The sheep pen has an opening at (12,0,5) for entry. All elements are within 15 blocks of spawn for compact navigation.
